q3.reason: ISRV2 failed the local development gate and was 7.33% slower in the 5-per-arm official practice sample.

q4.reason: Official practices showed a promising 21.13% sample improvement, but the local result was slower and the exact one-sided independent permutation p-value was 0.0514 with only five runs per arm.

official_batch.interpretation: Q4 is a high-priority follow-up candidate, but five independent practices per arm do not override the failed local development gate.

q4_isrv2_followup.interpretation: The initial five-run advantage did not reproduce in the frozen 30-run follow-up. ISRV2 has a better observed tail but no mean-time advantage.
